Details: Healthcare Enrollment & Reconciliation Automation — Synthetic Practice Dataset
Practice SQL/Business Analyst workflows comparing IE3 source records to a Mainframe extract, identifying discrepancies, classifying exceptions, and producing weekly/monthly reporting.
All records are synthetic and randomly generated for portfolio practice. They are not real members or Carelon production data.
Mainframe is simulated as a database extract table. SQL updates in this project do NOT connect to or change any real Mainframe/IE3 system.
Compare member_id across ie3_member and mf_member; member_id is the member-level key in each table.
Do not blindly overwrite all fields. Validate business rules and create a review/exception queue first.
If plan_status is TERMED_NONPAY, classify as SYSTEM_LIMITATION for manual review.
If pay_to_date < requested_effective_date, classify as SYSTEM_LIMITATION.
If APTC is zero and the scenario requires a dependent change/rerating, classify for review; do not assume a rate calculation.
For retro dependent cancellation, compare cancellation_effective_date with premium_effective_date; use custom_tab_* values as simulated returned rates, not as a universal premium formula.
Do not auto-update DOB, name, address, effective dates, premium, or APTC in production without approved source-of-truth rules and authorization.
MySQL 8.0+ / MySQL Workbench-compatible examples can be added separately. Date formats in Excel display as YYYY-MM-DD.
Healthcare Enrollment Reconciliation & Exception Reporting using SQL

1) Load sheets as tables. 2) Run joins and discrepancy checks. 3) Classify with CASE. 4) Review exception queue. 5) Report weekly/monthly metrics. 6) Demonstrate controlled simulated corrections with audit logging.
